use petgraph::{Graph, dot::Dot, visit::{IntoNeighbors, UndirectedAdaptor}};
fn main() {
    let mut graph = Graph::<u8, u8>::new();
    let a = graph.add_node(3);
    let b = graph.add_node(7);
    graph.add_edge(a, b, 11);
    let neighbors: Vec<_> = UndirectedAdaptor(&graph).neighbors(a).collect();
    assert_eq!(neighbors, vec![b]);
    assert_eq!(graph.edge_count(), 1);
    let dot = format!("{:?}", Dot::new(&graph));
    assert!(dot.contains("digraph"));
    println!("petgraph {} {}", graph.node_count(), graph.edge_count());
}
